## RQ2 — When does verifying pay? (pool=mixed, indist=True)

Mean net utility per cell; the winner is marked in bold. We look for the region where CCR beats optimistic_fallback and attestation_only.

| V \ kappa | k=0.05 | k=0.1 | k=0.2 | k=0.4 | k=0.6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| V=1 | CCR=-0.84 OPT=-2.47 ATT=-1.56 → **CCR** | CCR=-1.03 OPT=-2.47 ATT=-1.56 → **CCR** | CCR=-1.43 OPT=-2.47 ATT=-1.56 → **CCR** | CCR=-2.47 OPT=-2.47 ATT=-1.56 → **ATT** | CCR=-2.47 OPT=-2.47 ATT=-1.56 → **ATT** |
| V=2 | CCR=0.15 OPT=-1.50 ATT=-1.21 → **CCR** | CCR=-0.09 OPT=-1.50 ATT=-1.21 → **CCR** | CCR=-0.49 OPT=-1.50 ATT=-1.21 → **CCR** | CCR=-1.29 OPT=-1.47 ATT=-1.21 → **ATT** | CCR=-2.67 OPT=-1.47 ATT=-1.21 → **ATT** |
| V=5 | CCR=3.13 OPT=1.42 ATT=-0.17 → **CCR** | CCR=2.75 OPT=1.42 ATT=-0.17 → **CCR** | CCR=2.35 OPT=1.42 ATT=-0.17 → **CCR** | CCR=1.55 OPT=1.53 ATT=-0.17 → **CCR** | CCR=0.93 OPT=1.53 ATT=-0.17 → **OPT** |
| V=10 | CCR=8.10 OPT=6.28 ATT=1.57 → **CCR** | CCR=7.47 OPT=6.28 ATT=1.57 → **CCR** | CCR=7.07 OPT=6.28 ATT=1.57 → **CCR** | CCR=6.27 OPT=6.53 ATT=1.57 → **OPT** | CCR=5.90 OPT=6.53 ATT=1.57 → **OPT** |

CCR wins in **13/20** cells (typically high V / low kappa).


## RQ3 — Robustness to degradation (pool=clean, V=5, k=0.2)

attestation_only trusts valid signed cards; the honest but **degraded** agent is signed and its card is stale → it picks it and fails.

| policy | success@1 | net_utility | p95_ms |
|---|---|---|---|
| ccr | 0.9861 | 3.0528 | 984 |
| card_only | 0.5556 | 1.7778 | 638 |
| attestation_only | 0.5556 | 1.7778 | 638 |
| optimistic_fallback | 1 | 3.5139 | 809 |


## RQ4 — Canary-aware defection and mitigation (pool=mixed, V=5, k=0.2)

The defector passes the canary and fails the real task **only if it can tell the probe apart**. Making the canary indistinguishable (I) neutralizes it vs. distinguishable (D).

| CCR configuration | defection_rate | incident_rate | success@1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| distinguishable canary (D) — naive | 0.8542 | 1 | 0.8125 |
| indistinguishable canary (I) — mitigation | 0.1111 | 0.1389 | 0.9444 |


_Note: deterministic numbers; the Azure deployment reproduces them over real A2A._
